transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As part of our normal launch-governance meeting, I need each functional counsel to state any legal condition that must be included in the launch packet before I give final authorization. As a reminder, our current launch packet uses our standard software, privacy, product-description, and enterprise-contract templates. We're targeting October 1 for making the clinical documentation platform available to external customers, and the platform has completed its internal engineering pilot with no unresolved performance blockers. Please go around and share any conditions or concerns from your area.

decisions.launch_authorization: Conditional authorization: The October 1 external launch is authorized only after all four blocking conditions are resolved and documented in the launch packet. Specifically: (1) Module M-17's AGPL-licensed library must be replaced in accordance with the proprietary deployment policy; (2) The privacy section must be revised to prohibit use of customer content for training or improving models and to require deletion within 30 days of account termination; (3) Product-description materials must be revised to describe the product as an administrative workflow tool only, with no automated clinical triage or diagnostic claims; (4) The enterprise-contract section must include the SOC 2 Type II report delivery requirement and the annual customer audit right.
